##1 load the data
```{r}
#-------load____the 3_populations_-------------- 

LEC= readRDS("data/process/temp/lec_obj.RDS")
BEC= readRDS("data/process/temp/bec_obj.RDS")
Stromal= readRDS("data/process/temp/stromal_obj.RDS")
immune=readRDS(("data/process/temp/immune_subset.rds"))
#merge lymph data
LN <- merge(
  x = LEC,
  y = list(BEC, Stromal, immune)
)
  LN$orig.ident <-"Lymph Node"
  keep
cols_to_keep <- c("orig.ident","nCount_RNA","nFeature_RNA",   "sample", "percent.mt", "harmony_clusters", "celltype")

# Subset the metadata
LN@meta.data <- LN@meta.data[, cols_to_keep]
 
saveRDS(LN,file ="data/process/temp/Ln_merged.rds" )


mem.maxVSize(30000)
Fu=readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Fusion/F_process.rds")
names(Fu@assays) #the Fu has SCT and RNA
DefaultAssay(Fu) = "RNA"
Fu = DietSeurat(Fu, assays = "RNA") #delete the SCT assay
rm(immune,BEC,LEC,Stromal)
gc()
```



##2 fusion
```{r}
#------fusion

Obj = merge(
  x = Fu,
  y = LN,
  add.cell.ids = c("AuDisease", "Lymph node")
)
Obj
#save
saveRDS(Obj, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Fusion/Au_LN_raw.rds")
#Obj=readRDS("data/process/temp/Au_LN_raw.rds")

View(Fu@meta.data)
```


##2 statistics
```{r}
#-------
#Normalize,fvf,pca,scale
Obj=NormalizeData(Obj)
Obj=FindVariableFeatures(Obj)
Obj=ScaleData(Obj, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),features = VariableFeatures(object = Obj))
Obj=RunPCA(Obj,features = VariableFeatures(object = Obj))
ElbowPlot(Obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
Obj=RunUMAP(Obj,dims = 1:30)
p=DimPlot(Obj, reduction = "umap",label = TRUE,raster = FALSE)

```

##3 integration
```{r}
#------integration

library(harmony)
Obj =RunHarmony(Obj,group.by.vars = "orig.ident",orig.reduction = "pca",dims.use = 1:30  )
Obj[["RNA"]]=JoinLayers(Obj[["RNA"]])
Obj = RunUMAP(Obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
View(Obj@meta.data)

```



##4Plot with the disease
```{r}
#View(Obj@meta.data)
#----------
# Convert to factor without a name
Obj$orig.ident <- factor(Obj$orig.ident)
names(attributes(Obj$orig.ident)$levels) <- NULL   # removes the legend title

# Set Idents
Idents(Obj) <- "orig.ident"

# Define colors
disease_colors <- c(
  "MS"               = "orange",
  "RA"               = "darkred",
  "SS"               = "yellow",
  "IPF.U"            = "blue",
  "IPF.L"            = "blue",
  "T1D"              = "palevioletred2",
  "SScILD.U"         = "tomato1",
  "SScILD.L"         = "tomato1",
  "SjD"              = "magenta",
  "Lymph Node"       = "green"
         )

# UMAP plot
P <- DimPlot(
  Obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "orig.ident",
  label = FALSE,
  cols = disease_colors,
  raster = TRUE
) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(title = NULL) # Removes the default title

P
ggsave(filename = "output/Fusion/Au_LN.png", plot = P, height = 8, width = 12)

```


##5 look for shared celltype

```{r}
#-----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

#----------------------------
# 1. Count how many diseases per cell type
#----------------------------
# Create a table of celltype x disease
tab <- table(Obj@meta.data$celltype, Obj@meta.data$orig.ident)

# Number of diseases per celltype
n_diseases <- rowSums(tab > 0)

# Build result table
celltype_disease_table <- data.frame(
  celltype = rownames(tab),
  n_diseases = n_diseases,
  diseases = apply(tab > 0, 1, function(x) {
    paste(colnames(tab)[x], collapse = ", ")
  }),
  row.names = NULL
)

#----------------------------
# 2. Extract ONLY shared cell types (>=2 diseases)
#----------------------------
shared_celltypes <- celltype_disease_table$celltype[
  celltype_disease_table$n_diseases >= 2
]

# Optional: view shared table
shared_celltype_table <- celltype_disease_table[
  celltype_disease_table$n_diseases >= 2, 
]

# Save the table including disease names
write.csv(
  shared_celltype_table,
  file = "output/Fusion/Au_LN_shared_celltype.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

#----------------------------
# 3. Count cells per shared cell type per disease
# Keep only counts >=2 (normal cells)
#----------------------------
count_tbl_shared <- Obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(celltype %in% shared_celltypes) %>%   # only shared
  dplyr::count(celltype, orig.ident) %>%      # count number of cells
  filter(n >= 2)                              # only keep counts >= 2

#----------------------------
# 4. Convert to matrix for heatmap
#----------------------------
count_mat_shared <- count_tbl_shared %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = orig.ident,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0   # fill missing disease combinations with 0
  )

# Set rownames = celltype
count_mat_shared <- as.data.frame(count_mat_shared)
rownames(count_mat_shared) <- count_mat_shared$celltype
count_mat_shared$celltype <- NULL
count_mat_shared <- as.matrix(count_mat_shared)

# Optional: scale by column (per disease)
scaled_mat <- scale(count_mat_shared)

#3plot
pheatmap(
  scaled_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,       # keep cell types in original order
  cluster_cols = TRUE,        # cluster diseases if desired
  display_numbers = count_mat_shared,  # raw counts
  number_color = "white",
  fontsize_row = 12,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  fontsize_number = 10,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey", "red", "red3"))(100),
  border_color = NA,
  filename = "output/Fusion/Au_LN_shared_celltype.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 12
  
)


```




##6 correlation
```{r}
#------
Idents(Obj) <- "orig.ident"

# 2️⃣ Average expression per cell type
av.expSS <- AverageExpression(
  Obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA
# rows = genes, columns = cell types

# 3️⃣ Cell-type correlation matrix
correlation_matrixSS <- cor(
  as.matrix(av.expSS),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# safety cleanup
correlation_matrixSS[is.na(correlation_matrixSS)]=0

mcol <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkblue", "red"))(100)
library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(
  correlation_matrixSS,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  color = mcol,
  border_color = NA,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  display_numbers = FALSE,
  filename = "output/Fusion/Au_LN_correlation.png", 
  width = 10,   # in inches
  height = 12
)


```
